name: Hagane Seigi
source:
The player takes the role of Hagane Seigi, a high school student and otaku that is a member of his school's "Creative Society" (KaSouKen, an anime, manga, and game fanclub). Seigi goes about his everyday routine while maintaining a positive attitude, and his determination and burning spirit have gotten him through tough times when needed. He's not exactly the smartest guy in the world, but has proven to be very reliable.

[From [url=http://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/25642.html]Moroboshi Yuumei's review[/url]]
